Definition: from a provincial form of G5342 and G3529; victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family:--Bernice.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bernice appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Acts 25:13, Acts 25:23 and Acts 26:30.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bernice is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
